items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches Grid Protectors Program for flexible data center power use
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出Grid Protectors計畫，支援資料中心電力彈性
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced the Grid Protectors Program, a national effort for its future compute campuses to reduce electricity demand when the grid is under strain, working with utilities, regulators and policymakers. Georgia is the starting point: the planned Effingham County campus includes up to 1,000 MW of flexible demand response (roughly 700,000 households’ average usage) and OpenAI commits to covering full infrastructure and electric-service costs. Arrangements will vary by site, with options for on-site generation, storage and batteries.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布推出Grid Protectors計畫，這是一項全國性努力，讓其未來運算校園在電網緊張時降低電力需求，並與公用事業、監管機構與政策制定者合作。喬治亞州為起點：計畫中的Effingham County校園包含高達1,000 MW的彈性需求回應（約相當於70萬戶家庭平均用電），OpenAI承諾承擔全部基礎設施與電力服務成本。各地安排將有所不同，並可考慮現場發電、儲能與電池。
items_flat.analysis_en: The program positions OpenAI as a flexible load that can ease permitting and public pushback on AI power demand by helping utilities manage peaks, while the company still pays its full costs. Effectiveness will hinge on enforceable utility contracts and whether campuses can actually shed load without major disruption to training or inference; details for sites beyond Georgia are not yet public.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此計畫將OpenAI定位為可協助公用事業管理尖峰的彈性負載，有助減輕AI電力需求的許可與公眾阻力，同時公司仍全額支付自身成本。成效取決於可執行的公用事業合約，以及校園能否在不嚴重干擾訓練或推理的情況下真正降低負載；喬治亞州以外場址細節尚未公開。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re launching the Grid Protectors Program, a national effort to support affordable, reliable electricity for families and businesses in the communities where we build.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Grid Protectors計畫，這是一項全國性努力，旨在支持我們建設所在社區家庭與企業的可負擔、可靠電力。

brief_en: On Nov 2, OpenAI launched the Grid Protectors Program so its future US compute campuses can cut electricity demand during grid strain, starting with up to 1 GW flexible response at its planned Georgia site. No other major official model or product launches from tracked labs appeared in the last 12 hours.
brief_zh: 11月2日，OpenAI推出Grid Protectors計畫，讓未來美國運算校園在電網緊張時可降低電力需求，喬治亞州計畫場址提供高達1GW彈性回應。過去12小時內其他追蹤實驗室未見重大官方模型或產品發布。
